title: One entity within an existing (or standalone) feature

name.description: Entity name, singular or plural kebab/Pascal case (e.g. Todo, RewardClaim).

feature.description: Existing feature (src/features/{feature}) this entity's files land under. Defaults to the entity's own kebab-case name (a standalone feature).

remote.description: Emit a Supabase-backed repository and migration stub instead of a Dexie table (issue #172 §12).

layer.description: Restrict output to one core.yaml layer's files — "schema" emits only {module}.schema.ts, the table registration, and the src/db/schema.ts append; "repository" emits only the fixture, repository, and repository spec (issue #279). Omit to emit both in one run, matching the pre-#279 behavior.
